decisions.summary: Files: canonical list, sync-state JSON and hand-state JSON under research/; the GM's copy written by sync only; a session may hand-edit an entry's text
decisions.why: FR-001 beside the record, FR-007 sync record, FR-011 hand states in one file, US2 scenario 4 session edits

decisions.summary: Entry format and the three mark lines, with a dated recorded line
One-time import: header, high-risk section first, the GM's file unchanged; 1-6, 8, 12-16 downloaded and 7, 9, 10, 11 not found from the 2026-09-13 table; byte-for-byte re-derivation test

Ingest as a three-way comparison against synced.commit; marks recorded while text edits wait for KEEP=/DROP=; conflicts shown three ways; unknown ids named and pending; refused before the first sync; then the inbox
Ingest refuses found-elsewhere without downloaded or partial, and not-found with downloaded, partial or paywalled
decisions.why: Amended to FR-005 and US2 scenario 2 word for word; round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE narrowing is gone

decisions.summary: Sync refuses unless the copy's sha matches imported/synced/ingested or the copy is absent, naming entries; refuses on an uncommitted canonical list; records sha, date, commit
decisions.why: FR-007, US3; the uncommitted-list refusal binds only the session and keeps the base a commit

decisions.summary: make download-add from a draft; checks link, fallback, an existing record pointer, blocked-by; next number under the host-wide lock over mirror, clones and a ledger; appended at the end. HIGH_RISK=1 removed
decisions.why: FR-008, US4 scenario 1; round 1's high-risk-section insertion is dropped

decisions.summary: Inbox MATCH takes an entry id; resolves to its keys or []; saved-as files matched without asking; unmatched files wait
An entry's keys: backticked registry keys, manifest keys of linked URLs, optional '- Key:' line
decisions.why: definition the spec leaves open; serves FR-011 and the several-keys edge case

decisions.summary: Rule 1 mark mapping and several-entries rule; manifest rows: archived/earlier-snapshot open, gm-copy gm-full, a partial row whose page would not render whole but whose served text is kept open, other partial/unreachable to gone (404/410), down (timeout, network, 5xx), else bot-refused; most open row wins; no row with READ open, else never-read; hand state wins over 2-3 on same date or later, never over a mark that gives a state
decisions.why: FR-011 rules 1-4 and the hand-state rule as accepted; round 1's never-read override (old rule 3) is removed. The new partial mapping applies the request's own definition of open, 'read by us': measured 2026-10-02 (archive/*/*.json outcome and reason), 22 of 37 partial rows carry reason 'the page would not render whole: its served HTML and text are kept', i.e. the text was served to us and kept, not refused; the 15 others are HTTP 403 (13), 406, 429 and stay bot-refused, so US5 scenario 2 holds. This is the mapping the spec leaves to the states file, not a carve-out

decisions.summary: A keyless list entry (download:<id>) takes rule 1, then a hand-recorded state, else never-read
decisions.why: Amended to FR-011's rules for keyless entries, so D9a's list-entry seeds take effect; round 1's narrowing is gone

decisions.summary: Seeds: paywall prose in registry and list entries recorded by SET one by one, dated 2026-10-02, quoting the line; open, other-work and GM-full mentions passed over; the list goes in research.md
decisions.why: FR-011 seeding; skipping GM-full mentions stops a dated seed outranking the GM's copy

decisions.summary: make access-tags with KEY=, JSON=1, SET=
Guard download-copy-hooks.sh refusing Edit/Write/shell writes to the GM's copy with the add/sync commands; escape DOWNLOAD_COPY_OK, logged; companion test proven red
decisions.why: FR-009, SC-004; a logged escape with a reason is the project's standing guard form

decisions.summary: Push check against origin/main: lost id, reorder, a new id not after every main id, not numeric or not above main's highest, reused id, malformed marks; selftest first; passes while absent on main
decisions.why: FR-010; the H-section insertion allowance is removed, so every new entry is at the end

decisions.summary: Rule rewritten in CLAUDE.md, research/CLAUDE.md, the doctrine, record rules, page-session rules; ingest/sync documented; guard-table row
Tooling only, DIRECT route, no perf bookends or map reviews; reuse of Lock, inbox and guard-log helpers; make targets forwarded from the root Makefile
decisions.why: nothing on a map changes (spec Decisions)
